beatDescriptions.INVERT_PREMISE: Flip the assumed benefit on its head to create cognitive dissonance
beatDescriptions.CRITICAL_FLAW: Zoom into the hidden structural failure causing the problem
beatDescriptions.EXPERIMENT: Rapid whip between competing hypotheses to create investigative tension
beatDescriptions.BLOWUP: Everything fails spectacularly to justify the redesign
beatDescriptions.RECONSTRUCTION: Silent rebuild with deliberate camera orbit around the new architecture
beatDescriptions.TRIUMPH: Orbital celebration as the complete system proves itself end-to-end
